entry.text: Marsh Larkspur, hedge mage, has settled at the red cottage.
Leofric Quickfingers, scribe and almoner, has settled at the blue house.
Ida Tanner, scribe and almoner, has settled at the green cottage.
Cuthbert Larkspur, shepherd, has settled at the yellow house.
Jasper Emberhorn, lorekeeper, has settled at the lane cottage.
Maud Stonebridge, hunter, has settled at the tall house.
Hale Ashdown, millwright, has settled at the south cottage.
Freya Copperkettle, herbalist, has settled at the lakeside house.
Rook Briar, drill master at the yard, has settled at the red cottage.
Ottilie Haybarrow, scholar of small magics, has settled at the blue house.
Wyn Mistral, pedlar of odds and ends, has settled at the green cottage.
Haze Marrow, farmhand, has settled at the yellow house.
Cade Ashdown, wandering paladin, has settled at the lane cottage.
The village is founded: 13 souls under the valley's sky.

ev.text: Anything good at the market today?
No traders on the west road in days.

Fresh bread, and cheese that has seen better weeks.
Word has got round about our nights, I expect.
